reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Under Eye Patch Ginseng + Retinal 60P
reviews.text: Reasonably moisturising but better paired with a moisturiser underneath. Takes time applying for it to adhere properly due to the thickness of the material
reviews.zh: 保濕度算係 OK，但底層最好搭返一塊保濕霜。質料比較厚，要慢慢貼先可以貼得穩。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Under Eye Patch Ginseng + Retinal 60P
reviews.text: I put these on 20-30mins before I do my makeup and my undereyes feel so moisturized. They stick very well - you just need to tilt your head/lay flat for ~2mins to give them time to adhere then you can walk around without them ever falling off.
reviews.zh: 我會喺化妝前 20 至 30 分鐘貼，眼底即時覺得好保濕。貼服度好高——只要頭部傾斜或者平躺大概 2 分鐘，等佢黐實咗，跟住你周圍行佢都唔會跌。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Under Eye Patch Ginseng + Retinal 60P
reviews.text: I absolutely love these under-eye patches. They feel so cooling and soothing as soon as I apply them, which makes them perfect for tired or puffy eyes in the morning. After using them, the skin under my eyes feels incredibly silky, smooth and refreshed. They leave the area looking more hydrated and awake without feeling sticky or heavy. Such a lovely little self-care treat!
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢對眼膜。一貼上去已經覺得好涼爽好舒緩，啱晒朝早對住攰或者浮腫嘅眼仔。用完之後眼底皮膚變得絲滑、柔滑又煥然一新。眼底睇落更加保濕同精神，又唔會黐立立或者有負擔感。簡直係寵愛自己嘅小確幸！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Under Eye Patch Ginseng + Retinal 60P
reviews.text: I’ve been using these eye patches for a few weeks, and I’m genuinely impressed. They feel cooling and very comfortable on the skin, stay in place, and leave my under-eye area hydrated and refreshed. The combination of ginseng and retinal has helped make my fine lines look softer, while puffiness is noticeably reduced. My eyes look brighter and more awake after each use. Great quality, gentle on sensitive skin, and definitely worth repurchasing!
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢對眼膜幾個星期，認真覺得好滿意。佢貼上去涼涼地好舒服，又貼得實，用完眼底保濕又有光澤。人參同 retinal 嘅組合幫我令細紋望落柔和咗，浮腫都明顯減退咗。每次用完對眼都望落更加明亮有神。質素好好，敏感肌都啱用，絕對值得回購！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Under Eye Patch Ginseng + Retinal 60P
reviews.text:
I’m absolutely thrilled with **Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum: Ginseng + Retinal**! The results were noticeable after just the first few applications — the skin under my eyes looks firmer, fresher, and smoother. It provides great hydration without feeling heavy and absorbs quickly.

I carefully research the Korean beauty market, follow beauty bloggers, and choose products based on proven ingredients and real reviews. This formula truly delivers, thanks to the powerful combination of ginseng and retinal. The results exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend!
reviews.zh:
我對 **Beauty of Joseon Revive Eye Serum: Ginseng + Retinal** 真係超級滿意！頭幾次用已經見到明顯效果——眼底皮膚望落更加緊緻、有光澤又滑咗。保濕力強但唔會有厚重感，吸收得好快。

我一直有仔細研究韓國美妝市場、追蹤美妝博主，再揀啱有效成分同真實評價嘅產品嚟買。呢支嘅配方真係交到貨，全靠人參同 retinal 嘅強勁組合。效果超出我預期。勁力推薦！

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Under Eye Patch Ginseng + Retinal 60P
reviews.text:
Packaging: I love how the eye patch have been packaged. It comes with a big scooper (instead of a tweezer) which is a plus for me. For me, it is easier to scoop using a big spoon than a tweezer. 

Patches: I like the shape of the patches, they are cute and big. It covers my under eye very well. When you open the top cover, the smell of ginseng starts to linger. 

I usually use eye patches before bedtime but for BOJ I used it in the morning. It definitely smoothen my under eye and reduces puffiness 

The best thing of all, the patches do not cause any irritation or any allergic reactions as I have a super sensitive eye area
reviews.zh:
包裝：我好鍾意呢款眼膜嘅包裝。佢附咗一個大湯匙（而唔係鑷子），對我嚟講係加分位。對我嚟講，用大湯匙舀比用鑷子方便好多。

眼膜：我鍾意眼膜嘅形狀，又得意又大塊。佢好貼合我嘅眼底。打開上面個蓋，人參嘅味道就慢慢飄出嚟。

我平時都係瞓覺前先敷眼膜，但 BOJ 呢款我就喺朝早用。佢真係有平滑到我嘅眼底，同埋減淡咗浮腫。

最正嘅係，呢款眼膜完全冇引起刺激或者敏感反應，因為我眼周皮膚超級敏感。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Under Eye Patch Ginseng + Retinal 60P
reviews.text: On retinol nights, I use this eye mask first, followed by the eye cream from the same brand. This combination helps visibly reduce my dark circles while keeping the delicate under eye area hydrated and smooth. Retinol supports cell turnover, improves skin texture, and helps brighten the under eye area over time.
reviews.zh: 用 retinol 嘅日子，我會先用呢款眼膜，再用同一個品牌嘅眼霜。呢個組合可以明顯減淡我嘅黑眼圈，同時保持眼底肌膚水潤同光滑。Retinol 促進細胞更新、改善膚質，長遠有助提亮眼底。

reviews.shade: Beauty of Joseon Revive Under Eye Patch Ginseng + Retinal 60P
reviews.text: This really moisturizes the under eye area, but the patch is easy to rip if you’re not gentle. It also takes a minimum of 20 minutes to fully dry so I would only use this at night. Not a bad product but probably want to try a differently textured eye patch to see what works best for me. Also has a pretty strong herbal scent, so if you’re sensitive to smells I’d be wary of purchasing.
reviews.zh: 呢款眼膜真係有保濕到眼底，不過如果唔夠溫柔，眼膜好容易撕爛。佢要最少 20 分鐘先完全乾透，所以我只會夜晚先用。產品本身唔差，但我想試下唔同質地嘅眼膜，睇下邊種最適合我。藥草味都幾濃，如果你對氣味敏感，就要諗清楚先買。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
